name: openemr-dashboard
description: Patient dashboard port: React SPA (web) + Fastify backend-for-frontend (bff).

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n bff,web -c blue,magenta "npm run dev -w bff" "npm run dev -w web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w web && npm run build -w bff
scripts.test: npm run test -w bff && npm run test -w web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w bff && npm run typecheck -w web
